Tests were inspected, not rerun by this catalogue-only change. All partial rows require the stated missing acceptance; missing means no supported behavior in scope, not merely absent evidence. Unlisted natives are unaudited. Rows with reviewed_revision use that source snapshot; other rows use the top-level reviewed_revision.
